about_the_game:
Service Please: First Dinner

Build your restaurant, satisfy your customers, manage your staff, and perfect your service!
Service Please! is a detailed business simulation that takes you from building your restaurant from scratch to expanding and automating it.

🍽️ Build and Expand Your Restaurant
From floors to walls, from tables to chairs — every detail is up to you.
Each item has a prestige value. The higher your prestige, the more customers your restaurant attracts.
Create anything from a cozy diner to a luxurious fine-dining establishment.

🍴 Menu and Recipes
Design your own restaurant menu.
Food and drinks are divided into two main categories:

Foods:
Main dishes, soups, pizzas, fast food, and desserts.
Each recipe requires different ingredients and cooking stations.
Ingredient quality and cooking time affect customer satisfaction.

Drinks:
Alongside basic beverages, there are also coffees and alcoholic drinks.
Bartenders and baristas prepare the orders, while you decide which drinks complement which meals.
New recipes unlock as the game progresses.
As you expand your menu, both your income and prestige increase.

👨‍🍳 Kitchen and Production
Organize your drink cooler, pantry, and freezer.
Cook meals using stoves, ovens, and grills, then wash the dishes.
Every step affects your efficiency and profit.

🧑‍💼 Manage Your Staff
Hire waiters, chefs, dishwashers, bartenders, baristas, and couriers to form your team.
Each employee works at different speeds and efficiency levels depending on their role.
Assign the right people to the right jobs to grow your restaurant.

🌟 Prestige and Customers
Every item adds prestige points.
Higher prestige attracts more — and more diverse — customers.
As tip rates rise, so does your profit.

🧩 Skill Tree
As your restaurant serves more customers, new abilities unlock.
Skills speed up your workflow and simplify automation.
Your growth depends entirely on your management success.

⚙️ Automation
Leave manual work behind and turn your restaurant into a self-operating system!
Reach maximum efficiency with dishwashers, robot vacuums, auto-restocking bots, climate systems, delivery drones, and cold storage units.
Build a truly smart restaurant.

🏠 Decoration and Atmosphere
Choose floor and wall patterns, arrange lighting, and set the mood.
Every decorative choice impacts both prestige and customer satisfaction.
Create a place that reflects your unique style.

🚗 Expand Your Service Area
Serve not only inside your restaurant but outside as well.
Manage a drive-thru lane, direct your couriers, and even make deliveries by drone.
The larger your service area, the greater your profits.

💼 Every Decision Matters
Speed in the kitchen, order in service, taste in decoration…
Every decision affects customer satisfaction and prestige.
Service Please! is a living economic simulation driven entirely by the efficiency of the system you build.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Processor: Intel i3 / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 4GB
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Processor: Intel i5 or AMD equivalent (AMD FX 9500+ Series)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 4GB
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
